experiment: P3.1: source-reproduced hardware energy models of the 3.5 GHz and 7.2 GHz layers and the 7.2 GHz cell sleep ladder
status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-09, before the first measured run; AMENDMENT 1 (2026-11-09) after run 1 failed J1, R1 and R2, before run 2

amendments.trigger: run 1 (commit 31aa0a4): J1, R1 and R2 FAILED; evidence kept in results/phase3/p3_1_energy_models/run1/
diagnosis: J1: defect of our parser. In the .docx XML the caption 'Table 5.1-3' and its ':' are separate text runs, so the literal 'Table 5.1-3:' is absent. Tables 5.1-4/5 parsed and matched; the config numbers equal the expected strings.

R1: the Golard static term xi P_max / eta reproduces all 15 gamma, P0 and P1 values of 2505.15445 Table II exactly; the printed xi P_max^alpha does not (it is a misprint). N_C = 1 reproduces P_sleep of 4T4R and 64T64R exactly. 8T8R P_sleep is 389.88 W against 363.78 published (+7.2%) under N_C = 1 and is reproduced by neither pre-declared N_C. Result: 17/18, R1 FAILED. 64T64R, the configuration the project uses, is reproduced in all 6 values.

R2: arXiv v1 is superseded. The authors' code (github.com/e-peschiera/FR3-power-model, commit 255ed68, and the identical dramco-research/fr3-power-model-epeschiera-icassp26, commit 9e9fafe; README: 'source code to generate Figure 2a, 2b, 2c' of the ICASSP 2026 paper) and the accepted manuscript on KU Leuven Lirias differ from v1 in: static PA term xi P_max/eta; data phase x tau (1 - tau_sig); one LNA per antenna (M_ant/M_RF per RF chain); eta_s/c 0.81 in the code (the text says 0.8); upsilon_coh = (c/300 m)(lambda/(2 x 30 m/s)) = 500 at 10 GHz; per-M_RF rates from Fig. 2c x 0.93. The published numbers are 643 / 1389 W (full load, M_RF 16 / 1024), 253 / 849 W (30%), PA 3.3 / 209.9 W. The v1 numbers (740/1658/300/1044, 262/4) are reproduced by the v1 printed equations within about 1% except the fully digital totals (-6.4% / -11.4%), which remain unexplained and are moot.
changes: J1 parser matches captions on tag-stripped text.
The FR3 model implements the PUBLISHED version (ICASSP 2026: Lirias manuscript + authors' code) for the project; v1 is kept only to re-record its failed reproduction.

New gate J2c: our published-mode implementation equals an independent re-implementation of the code's formulas (Fig_2a.py totals for M_RF in {16..1024}, Fig_2b.py PA for M_ant in {16..1024}; loads 0, 0.3, 1) to rel 1e-12.
New gate R2pub replaces R2 in the pass rule: published totals 643 / 1389 / 253 / 849 W within 2% and PA 209.9 W within 2% and 3.3 W within 0.1 W.

New gate R1u: 64T64R (the only sub-6 configuration the project uses) reproduced in all 6 values within the R1 tolerance under (golard, N_C = 1). The original R1 stays recorded as FAILED and is not re-scored.
Project 7.2 GHz layer: published equations, eta_s/c 0.81 (equal to the 3.5 GHz layer's 0.9 x 0.9 for PA and AFE), one LNA per antenna, upsilon_coh by the code's rule at 7.2 GHz (about 694).
Pass rule: J0-J5, J2c, R1u and R2pub must pass; R1 and R2 (v1) are recorded, expected to fail as in run 1, and excluded from the pass rule by this amendment.
amendments.declared_not_blind: R1u and R2pub are NOT blind: run 1 already showed the 64T64R values under (golard, N_C = 1), and a scratch re-implementation of the authors' code (post-hoc diagnostic, scratchpad/diag_p31_fr3_code.py) already gave 643.1 / 1389.3 / 252.9 / 848.8 W and 209.9 / 3.28 W. These gates check that the project implementation equals what was diagnosed. J2c is the substantive new check.

protocol: docs/PHASE_3_ENERGY_PROTOCOL.md, P3.0 revision 1, decisions D1-D4 and D10
nature: model construction and source reproduction; no scientific prediction is scored in P3.1
declared_before_registration: All sources were read before registration (P3.0 and its revision 1); the TR 38.864 tables were re-read from the .docx while writing the table parser (same values as P3.0).

Partial arithmetic done by hand while reading, and nothing else: (i) gamma of 64T64R with Golard eq. 5 (eta_max about 0.287, gamma about 3.50 with eta_s/c 0.81), which does not depend on the static-term form or on N_C; (ii) a rough FR3 PA term at 100 W and full load (about 690 W, printed static form, signalling and idle terms ignored), against the published 740 W total at 16 RF chains; (iii) P_misc and P_TRX of 64T64R (about 63.9 W and 3.18 W).
No P0, P1 or P_sleep of Table II and no FR3 total or component sum was computed before registration.

tr38864.transition_rule: during the total transition time T the relative power of the sleep state is consumed; the additional transition energy E comes on top (Table 5.1-2); T and E are the same for every set of a category
tr38864.not_used: the TR active-state scaling (P_static, P_dyn, A, s_a, s_f, s_p) is not used: active and micro-sleep powers come from the component models (D4)

golard_table2.notes: LTE tau_sig 2/7 and zeta_sig 2/6, NR 1/14 and 1/12; alpha of 2505.15445 = 1 - n = 0.75; eta_max by Golard eq. 5: eta_tech / (1 + a (P_max/P*) (f/f*)^2 + b (P*/P_max))

sub6_table2_published.source: arXiv 2505.15445v1 Table II (PDF = HTML); left value delta_dtx_PA = 1 and delta_idle_TRX = 1, right value 0.25 and 0.5

sub6_recompute.equations: 2505.15445 Sec. III-D closed forms (gamma, P0/M, P1/M, P_sleep) with eqs. (6)-(9) and Golard eqs. (5), (8)-(11)

static_form.printed: xi P_max^alpha / eta_max (2505.15445 and 2510.10647 as printed)

n_c.meaning: number of cells N_C in Golard's P_link^ref / N_C^alpha3; 2505.15445 calls P_link^ref 'a constant' and considers 'one cell', without fixing N_C; 3 = a three-sector site

sub6_recompute.gate_R1: PASS if at least one of the four (static_form, n_c) interpretations reproduces all 18 published values (3 configurations x gamma, P0 left/right, P1 left/right, P_sleep) within tolerance; that interpretation is then the identified one. Every interpretation's errors are reported. FAIL stops P3.1.

fr3_model.source: arXiv 2510.10647v1 eqs. (5)-(17), Sec. 3-4, implemented as printed

digital.subcarrier_rule: fixed FFT size; subcarrier spacing scales with bandwidth (Sec. 3.1: 'the number of subcarriers is fixed and different subcarrier spacings give different bandwidths'): df = 120 kHz x B / 400 MHz
digital.precoder: FPGA, static x ceil(M_RF/32); Xi = 2K + (K^3/(3 M_RF) + 3K^2 + K)/upsilon_coh
digital.fft: ASIC; Xi = 1.5 log2(Q); IFFT (DL) and FFT (UL)
digital.bb_filter: FPGA, static x ceil(M_RF/32); Xi = n o = 20 x 4; DL and UL

analog.chains: P_ana,DL,1 = 2 DAC + 2 RF filter + 2 mixer + M_PS PS; P_ana,UL,1 = 2 ADC + 2 RF filter + 2 mixer + M_PS PS + LNA; P_ana,i = LO + M_RF P_ana,i,1; hybrid partially connected M_PS = M_ant/M_RF, fully digital M_PS = 0

pa.count: one PA per antenna; P_a = P_T,DL / M_ant

frame.as_printed: eqs. (6), (12), (16): data x tau P + signalling tau tau_sig P + micro tau (1-x)(1-tau_sig) P delta + idle (1-tau) P delta; the frame fractions sum to 1 + tau x tau_sig (data and signalling overlap); implemented as printed

signalling_power.project: zeta_sig P_a (Golard's definition P_sig = zeta_sig P_full); identical when P_a = P_max

published.note: eta_s/c 0.81 is the code's value and the one that produces the published numbers; the printed text says 0.8

upsilon_rule_published.formula: upsilon_coh = (c / dist_max) x (lambda_c / (2 v)), the authors' code

fr3_published_reference.source: amendment 1: ICASSP 2026 accepted manuscript (Lirias) Sec. 4 and the authors' Fig_2a.py / Fig_2b.py

rates_gbps_times_0p93.rule: fixed per M_RF, independent of load (as in the code)

upsilon_coh.rationale: samples per coherence block are not stated; 200 is a common massive-MIMO coherence-block length; the term enters only the precoder-matrix computation and scales as 1/upsilon_coh

rates.rule: R_i = R_i,full x_i for every M_RF (the text gives 'more than 13 Gbit/s' DL and 'more than 2 Gbit/s' UL for fully digital at full load); they enter only the encoder and decoder, whose dynamic power is reported as a bound

targets.what: PA of M_ant = 16 PAs (P_T = 100 x 16/1024 W)
targets.tol: abs 0.5 W (published value rounded to 1 W)

pa_bar_interpretations.primary: P_PA / eta_PA,s/c (the contribution to P_cons; Fig. 2's axis is P_cons)

fr3_reference_reproduction.gate_R2: PASS if T1-T4 are within tolerance with upsilon_coh = 200 and T5-T6 are both within tolerance under one PA-bar interpretation, all with the printed static form, or, if R1 identifies the Golard form, with that form. The upsilon_coh sensitivity, the encoder/decoder bound and a time-consistent frame variant are reported as diagnostics only and are not routes to a pass. FAIL stops P3.1.

layer_3p5.model: 2505.15445 compact model (5), published Table II 64T64R (AAU, TDD, 3.5 GHz, 100 MHz, 64 PAs x 3.125 W = 53 dBm); this is case C at 3.5 GHz
layer_3p5.operating_point: M_a = M = 64 (no antenna muting), P_a = P_max, time-domain load N_a/N = L
layer_3p5.decomposition: PA / AFE / DBB parts from the recompute, only under the interpretation identified by R1

layer_7p2.architecture: M_RF < M_ant: hybrid partially connected, M_PS = M_ant / M_RF; M_RF = M_ant: fully digital, M_PS = 0

53dBm_assumedPA.label: assumed PA: an element PA sized to the 53 dBm requirement with the SiGe reference's efficiency parameters; eta_3p5 = Golard eq. 5 at 3.125 W and 3.5 GHz (the 3.5 GHz layer's own PA), an optimistic bound

50dBm_SiGe.label: source-exact: the FR3 paper's 100 W, 1024-antenna hardware at 7.2 GHz / 200 MHz

43dBm_SiGe.label: source-exact SiGe at Nokia's second 7 GHz level

layer_7p2.static_form: the static PA form under which R2 passes; if both forms pass, the one identified by R1
layer_7p2.version_amendment_1: published (static golard, frame consistent, one LNA per antenna, eta_s/c 0.81); upsilon_coh by fr3_model.upsilon_rule_published at 7.2 GHz; supersedes static_form above
layer_7p2.frame: as fr3_model.frame (TDD 0.75 / 0.25, as Golard NR TDD; TR 38.864 DDDSU with S = 10D:2G:2U gives 0.743 / 0.229)

ladder.anchor: P_mu = FR3 P_cons with x_DL = x_UL = 0 and tau_sig = 0: every chain in micro sleep in its own direction and idle in the other (D4)
ladder.states: P_light = w P_light,TR; P_deep = w P_deep,TR; E_add = w E_TR x 1e-3 J; T from Table 5.1-4
ladder.dl_anchor_sensitivity: w_DL = P_DL,inst / P_active_dl,TR(set1), with P_DL,inst the instantaneous power of a full-load DL data symbol (DL chains active, UL chains idle, PAs at P_a); reported only to show the anchoring effect (P3.0's original rule)
ladder.breakeven: for each sleep state, the shortest sleep that saves energy against staying on and empty (P_empty, signalling on): max(T, E_add / (P_empty - P_sleep))
ladder.availability: full T after a wake request (primary), T/2 (sensitivity); used in P3.3, recorded here

gates.J0_sources: every file in 'sources' is supplied to the run and matches its SHA-256
gates.J1_tr_transcription: the rows of TR Tables 5.1-3, 5.1-4, 5.1-5 parsed from the .docx equal docx_expected_rows, and the numeric tables of this config equal those strings
gates.J2a_fr3_two_implementations: the closed-form FR3 implementation equals an independently written phase-ledger implementation (rel <= 1e-12) on every reference target, every project point and load, and for P_mu
gates.J2b_sub6_compact_vs_direct: the compact model (5) with the closed-form parameters equals the direct per-state sum of eqs. (6)-(9) (rel <= 1e-12) for every configuration, case and interpretation on a grid of L in {0, 0.3, 1}, M_a in {K+1, M}, P_a in {0.5 P_max, P_max}
gates.J3_rf_pa_consistency: D10: per-PA outputs and SiGe limits equal d10_expected; every project point has P_a <= P_max (assumed-PA points by construction, SiGe points checked); 53 dBm with SiGe is flagged infeasible
gates.J4_state_consistency: for every project point and both layers: all powers > 0; P_deep < P_light < P_mu < P_empty <= P(load) non-decreasing over the equal-load grid; E_add >= 0; the ledger accepts the worked example with the exact energy and rejects a sleep shorter than T, two adjacent sleeps and a non-positive duration
gates.J5_units: W, s, J only: the TR conversion relative-power x ms -> J is checked on a worked example (w = 2 W per unit, E = 90 units x ms -> 0.18 J)
gates.rule: all J and R gates must pass; a failed gate stops P3.1 and is diagnosed in an amendment; failed-run evidence is kept
gates.J2c_fr3_vs_authors_code: amendment 1: published-mode fr3_power equals an independent re-implementation of the authors' Fig_2a.py totals (M_RF in m_rf_vec, M_ant 1024) and Fig_2b.py PA (M_ant in m_rf_vec, M_RF = M_ant), loads 0, 0.3, 1, rel <= 1e-12
gates.R1u_sub6_used_config: amendment 1: 64T64R gamma, P0 left/right, P1 left/right, P_sleep within the R1 tolerance under (golard, N_C = 1) (not blind)
gates.rule_amendment_1: J0, J1, J2a, J2b, J2c, J3, J4, J5, R1u and R2pub must pass. R1 and R2 (v1) are recorded and excluded from the pass rule. J0 also covers the four amendment-1 sources.
